justifications.type_expressiveness: Error enum has meaningful variants carrying relevant data (OutOfRange(u32), InvalidChar(char)), though NonCanonical could be more granular about why parsing failed.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with distinguishing variants and no library panics in normal flow, but uses unreachable!() in value_of without a documented safety comment.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Reasonable derives on RomanError and Display is implemented, but no doc comments on any public items and std::error::Error is not implemented.
justifications.idiomaticity: Generally idiomatic with iterators, slice indexing, and derives, but the manual byte-index while loop and unreachable!() over an exhaustive match-after-validate could be refactored more cleanly.
